Package dayplanner

Class DayPlanner

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.DayPlanner
public class DayPlanner extends Object

Main application class and execution entry point for DayPlanner.

Loads the configured activity files, runs the interactive menu, and saves changes when the user quits.
